description: AKAC 0.5 draft runtime containment vectors (ADR-012, spec/drafts/0.5-runtime-containment.md). Synthetic data. kind 'profiles': the pure derivation containment(state, 'acme', level, destinationClass) over kbFixture(clock) with patches, level = highest transitive classification of `sources`; expected {ok, obligations} or {ok: false, reason}; with `destinationClasses` the merged derivation containmentAcross(state, 'acme', level, destinationClasses) is used instead. kind 'engine': Engine over the same state; openContext, release (after openContext) to `recipient`, evaluate or derive (after openContext); only runtime_profile and max_output_classification obligations are compared; `code` is the reason code of the last audit entry. kind 'enforcer': ProtectedRuntime.answer with a scripted enforcer (`supports` lists domain/profile pairs it has templates for; `fail` makes apply reject, supports throw, the execution's current revision drift, drift only after the final release (late-drift) or the lease release reject) or none; the scripted enforcer is execution-scoped (apply returns a lease, current(executionId) reports its revision); `runtimeRevision` is the value recorded on the last audit entry of an allowed answer; `applied` lists the profiles passed to apply(). Profile ids are opaque examples of operator-reviewed templates.

cases.description: No runtime profile policy: no runtime obligation, exactly the 0.4 behaviour
Only inactive policies: no runtime obligation
Public material: only the public tier applies; the output label is public
Confidential material: public and confidential tiers apply, restricted does not
Restricted material: the higher tier wins per domain (deny-all over internal-only)
A public document in a restricted folder is restricted (container floor, R25)
max_output_classification is the transitive classification: a public-labelled artifact derived from restricted material is restricted
Mixed sources: the highest classification of all sources selects the tier
Destination narrowing: towards a model provider the narrowed policy wins at equal tier
Destination narrowing does not apply to another destination class
Destination narrowing does not apply to a decision without destination (read)
A narrowed policy above the material classification does not apply
Conflict: two policies of the same tier name different network profiles: deny, never a guess
Two policies of the same tier naming the same profile are no conflict
Conflict between two narrowed policies for the same destination class: deny
A conflict in a tier that does not apply does not affect lower material
A malformed stored policy (no profile) defers
A policy that names a model-generated or free-text profile (not an identifier) is malformed and defers
Another tenant's conflicting policies neither apply nor deny
No reachable destination class (a run restricted to Destination ids that resolve to nothing): containmentAcross denies instead of falling back to the unnarrowed derivation (R122)
containmentAcross over one reachable class equals the derivation for that class (external-narrowed profile wins)
openContext on restricted material carries the restricted runtime profiles
openContext without policies: no runtime obligation (0.4 behaviour)
openContext with conflicting policies denies with UNSUPPORTED_OBLIGATION
A release to a model provider applies the policy narrowed to model-provider
A read-only evaluation naming the model-provider destination applies the narrowed policy
A read evaluation of public material carries the public tier
Runtime policies never widen access: an uncleared reader is still denied
derive from restricted material carries the restricted runtime profiles
A share evaluation naming no destination in an unrestricted run is denied (RECIPIENT, R121): never allowed without a recipient check, never the weaker unnarrowed profile (R109)
A share evaluation naming no destination in a run restricted to one Destination id is denied (RECIPIENT, R121); 0.5 allowed it with destination_restricted
A share evaluation naming no destination in a run restricted to internal users is denied (RECIPIENT, R121)
A release to a service principal without a Destination profile in an unrestricted run is contained for every class it could forward to: a differing external-narrowed profile denies (R109)
A release to a user without a Destination profile applies the policy narrowed to internal-user (D = internal-user, R109)
A share evaluation naming the Destination of a run restricted to it applies the profile narrowed to that destination class (R109)
A share evaluation naming an inactive Destination of a run restricted to it is denied (RECIPIENT); no fallback to the unnarrowed profile (R122)
Runtime profile obligations and no enforcer: deny before the provider
Enforcer without a template for one profile: deny before the provider
Enforcer supports and applies every profile: allow; its revision is recorded on the answer
Enforcer apply fails: deny before the provider
Enforcer reports a malformed revision: deny before the provider
Enforcer supports() throws: deny before the provider
No policy and no enforcer: allowed exactly as in 0.4, nothing recorded
A model-provider-narrowed policy supersedes the context profile for the provider hop (R112): the provider gate profile is applied, not a conflict
A caller-supplied runtime revision is never recorded
Two model-provider-narrowed policies of the same tier name different network profiles: a genuine conflict denies before the provider (R110)
The enforcer reports another revision for the execution after the provider call: the answer is denied (R112)
The lease release fails: the answer is denied (R112)
The runtime revision changes after the final release but before the answer is returned: the answer is withheld and the denial audited (R124)
A higher tier that is not narrowed beats a lower tier that is narrowed to the destination class
An inactive policy of a higher tier does not apply
A stored policy with an extra member is malformed and defers
A stored policy with a classification outside the closed set is malformed and defers
A stored policy narrowed to an unknown destination class is malformed and defers
A stored policy with a profile that is not an identifier is malformed and defers
A stored policy whose active flag is not a boolean is malformed and defers
A stored policy filed under another id than its own is malformed and defers
An inactive malformed policy still defers: the tenant set must be well formed
A stored policy naming an unknown domain is malformed and defers
